description: View or set permissions for tools on a connected MCP server — which tools are allowed, rate limits, budget caps, argument restrictions. Pass the connector slug (from connector_list) and action: "list" to see current rules, or action: "set" with tool_name + rules to update one. Team scope requires admin role.

action.description: Omit to list permissions for all tools. Pass "set" with tool_name + rules to update one.

allowed.description: Whether the tool is allowed (for set).

arg_natural_language_rules.description: Plain English rules for argument filtering (for set). Example: "Only allow queries for the last 90 days."

arg_schema_rules.description: JSON Schema validating tool arguments (for set). Example: {"properties":{"channel":{"enum":["#general"]}}}

billing.description: Scope: "personal", "team" (auto-resolves if on one team), a team slug, or "team:<id>".

budget_per_day.description: Max daily spend per user, in millicents (for set).

cost_per_call.description: Cost in millicents per call (for set).

nl_filter_mode.description: How to enforce NL rules: strict (block on violation) or advisory (log only). Default: strict.

rate_limit_per_day.description: Max calls per day, per user (for set).

rate_limit_per_hour.description: Max calls per hour, per user (for set).

team_budget_per_day.description: Max daily spend team-wide, in millicents (for set).

team_rate_limit_per_day.description: Max calls per day, team-wide (for set).

team_rate_limit_per_hour.description: Max calls per hour, team-wide (for set).

tool_name.description: Tool name (for set). Use "*" for all tools on this connector.

name: connector_permissions
title: Connector Permissions
